# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Schedule an inspection and identify important dates.
3. Observe the bridge carefully.
4. Document the components accurately.
5. Take measurements of defects.
6. Use consistent terminology.
7. Use visuals.

## Start with the maintenance records

Collect and review all existing maintenance records for the bridge. This provides a history of known issues, previous repairs, and overall condition trends. Understand what work has been done before, when it was done, and what the results were.

## Schedule an inspection and identify important dates

Schedule the bridge maintenance inspection when there is little to no traffic. Also, jot down the date and time of the inspection when you get there. This is important for future checks.

## Observe the bridge carefully

Observe the bridge carefully and methodically, systematically working through all components. Consider safety first and utilize appropriate access equipment (lifts, ropes, etc.) to reach all areas. Be aware of the environment (
